scope: Retrospective same-batch anonymous-origin seven-class probability and decision study; real uploaded spectra

source_models.svm: predeclared SNV source scaler, RBF SVC C10, balanced source weights, OVR scores
source_models.mlp: locked b006, SNV/source scaler/noPCA/64-32/ReLU/200epochs/Adam lr.001 wd.001/CE none
source_models.mlp_sup100: same b006 initializer plus matched supervised continuation100, Adam.0001, full-source CE anchor1 and source-episode query CE, no FO used

oof.policy: classes with n<3 are source anchors included in every training fold and excluded from heldout OOF labels; all other records validated exactly once
oof.development_excluded_oof_class: ZY02 source n1; OOF306 common-class rows only, retains7 score columns
oof.final_all_classes: source ZY02n3 permits ordinary threefold OOF513, source train342 eachfold

decision.fixed_zero_bias_classes: reference ZY01 plus classes source count<3

selection.classification_ranking: MacroF1 descending, accuracy descending, raw before others on ties, candidateID
selection.probability_branch: temperature must improve NLL and satisfy Brier guard in both selection and gate, otherwise raw

probability_metrics.NLL: mean negative log p_true with floor1e-15
probability_metrics.Brier: mean(sum over7 squared error), no divide7
probability_metrics.ECE: 10 equal-width max-confidence bins, probability argmax correctness, not decision-bias prediction correctness

interpretation: temperature alone cannot improve hard classification
no 0.5 binary threshold for seven classes
OOF singleton exclusion limits probability fit for rare group
original171 target calibration pool completely unused
same-batch historical query exposure; no fresh confirmatory or newbatch claim
three seeds are not independent batches
